    arm_center_y = (pivot_y + spring_anchor_y) / 2
    
    # Create the arm beam
    arm = sandbox.add_beam(
        x=arm_center_x,
        y=arm_center_y,
        width=2.0,  # Width of the arm beam
        height=0.2,
        angle=math.atan2(spring_anchor_y - pivot_y, spring_anchor_x - pivot_x),
        density=2.0,
    )
    
    # Add pivot joint to the ground
    sandbox.add_joint(arm, None, (pivot_x, pivot_y), type="pivot")
    
    # Define spring parameters
    rest_length = 1.0  # Compressed spring for more energy storage
    stiffness = 2800.0  # Higher stiffness for stronger launch
    damping_ratio = 0.2

        arm,
